predictions.title: Who will be appointed Peru's foreign minister in the incoming presidential administration's first cabinet in July 2026?
predictions.reasoning: Keiko Fujimori secured an insurmountable lead in Peru's June 2026 presidential runoff (50.12% with 99.86% counted on June 24) and takes office July 28, but has not yet leaked her Torre Tagle pick. predictions.title: Which commodity category will record the largest monthly percentage price increase in the FAO Food Price Index for August 2026?
predictions.reasoning: The FAO Food Price Index comprises exactly five commodity categories: Sugar, Vegetable Oils, Cereals, Dairy, and Meat.
